title: LDA & QDA
interviewAnswer: Linear and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis model class-conditional Gaussian distributions. LDA shares covariance across classes and yields linear boundaries; QDA allows class-specific covariance and quadratic boundaries.
keyPoints: Generative classifiers model p(x|y) and priors.
LDA lower variance; QDA more flexible.
Covariance estimation can be unstable in high dimensions.
why: LDA & QDA is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
intuition: Generative classifiers model p(x|y) and priors.
deepDive: Linear and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis model class-conditional Gaussian distributions. LDA shares covariance across classes and yields linear boundaries; QDA allows class-specific covariance and quadratic boundaries. LDA lower variance; QDA more flexible. Covariance estimation can be unstable in high dimensions. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: Classify two well-separated Gaussian populations with LDA when a shared covariance is plausible.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
followUps: What assumptions or limitations does LDA & QDA have?
How would you validate LDA & QDA on a real dataset?
production: In production, make assumptions explicit, validate on representative slices, compare with a simple baseline and monitor the signals that can drift.
